title: E M5 selected formal-eval display cases with verified six-method map previews

cases.selection_rule: 六方法四项逐图指标的名次画像与 model-correct cohort 中位画像 L1 距离为 0；并列按高置信度、再按较小 image_id。

cases.selection_label: 质量与稳定性名次取舍
cases.selection_rule: raw MoRF AUC 与输入噪声 Spearman 的方法名次差平方和为 70，与 image_id 4675 并列；按较小 image_id 选中 3803。
387 张命中样本中置信度最低（0.539305）；预测仍命中真值类别，不是误分类。

limitations: E selected 215, 3803 and 7612 using reproducible, outcome-dependent rules; selection was not preregistered. Cross-member acknowledgement and independent Demo reproduction remain pending.
The primary handoff ZIP contains metrics and configs; formal attribution previews and NPY hashes come from the separately hashed case package below.
Formal PNG, NPY and provenance hashes are recorded per map and checked against the case package index.
VOC target is one metadata label; this is not VOC mAP or a multi-label exact-match metric.

source_map_package.display_note: PNG files are the archive-provided 224x224 grayscale previews. Quantitative maps remain float32 NPY; previews are not used for metric calculations.

case_selection_status: E selected display cases 215, 3803 and 7612 using reproducible rules; not preregistered. Independent Demo reproduction and Issue #22 synchronization remain pending.

map_display_policy.preview: Original archive-provided 224x224 grayscale PNG export, copied byte-for-byte.
map_display_policy.quantitative_source: float32 NPY; NPY is not copied into this lightweight Demo.
map_display_policy.interpretation: PNG previews are qualitative. Do not compare grayscale intensity across methods as a shared absolute scale; use the raw metrics and NPY source for quantitative work.
map_display_policy.integrity: PNG, raw NPY, provenance sidecar, source configuration, protocol, stability configuration and source archive SHA-256 values are recorded per map.
